description: A dermatophyte infection of the scalp and hair.
symptoms: Inflammation may occur in some forms
causes: Dermatophyte fungi infecting the scalp and hair

appearance.general: Patchy scalp scaling and hair loss may occur; inflammatory forms can produce more marked scalp inflammation.

warning_signs: Painful, markedly inflamed scalp lesions or significant hair loss warrant medical assessment.
doctor_discussion_points: Discuss fungal testing of scalp scale or hairs.
Discuss hair loss and whether other sites such as feet or nails are affected.
